task: Known-perturbation replication across complementary nonoverlapping donor pairs

protocol.mask: Finite in destination row and every source-pair row in its condition, identical for transfer, baseline and all null permutations
protocol.condition_mean: All available source-pair effects in the same condition, including matched targets; no destination outcomes
protocol.null: Permute source target assignments among matched targets within each condition, allowing fixed points
protocol.mse: Mean per-row MSE, then equal row mean
protocol.spearman: Per-row Spearman over common finite readout genes; constant or <3-readout rows excluded

limitations: Three complementary partitions and six directions reuse the same four donors; not six independent cohorts
Known perturbations, not unseen-target prediction or causal model validation
QC-selected effects and earlier frozen development target panel
Same deposited DE estimation procedure may yield shared analysis biases
Null quantiles are permutation reference ranges, not biological confidence intervals
